notes.title: Release Notes for 25/05/2024
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Engine: Updated engine version.
 Visual: Added environmental effects to all maps.

Bug Fixes:

 Badges: Fixed an issue where Upgrade Badge descriptions wouldn't show.
 Music: Fixed a bug that caused Tyr battle music to not stop upon player death.
 Physics: Adjusted pillar destruction physics.
 Performance:

 Memory management improvements.
 Lighting optimizations on all maps.

notes.title: Release Notes for 14/05/2024
notes.notes:
User Interface

Early Access: Added an Early Access notice at the startup.

Bug Fixes

Item Stats: Fixed an issue that sometimes caused item stats to not update correctly.
Executable: Game executable icon is now displaying correctly on the applications menu.
Performance: Lighting optimizations on mapsand stability improvements.

notes.title: Release Notes 26/04/2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

UI: Fixed an issue where the stats window would not show up when hovered over an item.
Maps: Optimization improvements on background assets for better performance.
Stability: Fixed an issue that caused the game to hang in some cases.

notes.title: Release Notes for 22/04/2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Localization: Fixed texts with missing or incorrect localization settings.
 Weaponsmith: Fixed a bug that blocked players from upgrading weapons despite having sufficient funds.
 Maps: Adjusted collisions on various maps for better navigation.

notes.title: Release Notes for 20/04/2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

User Interface: Tutorial videos can no longer show up on top of badge selection screens.
Badge Chests: Fixed an issue that caused Loki Badge Chest to spawn twice.
Updates: Introduced a version check, this will help prevent save files from corrupting in future updates.

notes.title: Release Notes for 19/04/2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Items: Resolved an issue where temporary bonus items were not being removed as intended.
 Balance: Fixed an issue that allowed damage received from enemies to be entirely negated.
 Controller: Fixed an issue that interfered with purchasing weapon attachments using a controller.
 Stabiltiy: Performance improvements on Muspelheim.

notes.title: Release Notes for 18/04/2024
notes.notes:
Balance Changes

 Damage: Damage received from enemies has been adjusted.
 Health Rune: Now restores health for every 5 enemies killed instead of 2.

Bug Fixes

 	Bosses: Fixed an issue where boss fights would not initiate after the fourth encounter.
 	Rage Mode: Fixed an issue where players remained stuck in Rage Mode even after its duration had expired.
 	Controller: Fixed a bug that interfered with performing Glory Kills using a controller.
 	Dungeon Rewards: Players no longer lose rewards for the last cleared dungeon upon giving up. (Does not apply to Nightmare mode)
 	Rune Badge: Fixed an issue that prevented acquired Rune Badges from being saved.
 	Audio: Fixed an issue that prevented audio settings from being saved.
 	Language: Fixed texts with missing localization settings.
 	Stability: Memory improvements to reduce crash problems.

notes.title: Release Notes 17/04/2024
notes.notes:
User Experience

User Interface: Added a splash screen and a photosensitivity warning for safety.

Balance Changes

 Adjustments to Great Sword:

 Increased attack range to improve combat reach.
 Decreased recovery time for the last combo attack to enhance responsiveness.
 Dash-Attack now includes a slight knock-back effect.
Overall, these changes aim to make the weapon feel less sluggish.

Bug Fixes

 Rage Mode: Fixed an issue where players remained stuck in Rage Mode after switching maps.
 Dialogues: Fixed an issue that prevented some dialogues from playing.
 Save Slots: Fixed an issue that caused save slots to display "Unknown" as the location.
 Ultimate Badges: Reintroduced a previously removed badge after fixing underlying functionality issues.
 Maps: Made collision and layout adjustments to certain maps for smoother navigation.
 Stability: Made memory improvements to reduce crash problems.

notes.title: Day One Patch 16/04/2024
notes.notes:
Language


 Translation improvements.

Bug Fixes


 Fixed a problem where dash wouldn't work on certain maps.
 Adjusted difficulty of waves to be more balanced.
 Bosses no longer take damage outside of fights.
 Fixed an issue where defeating bosses wouldn't drop reward chests.
 Improvements on optimization and crash problems.

notes.notes:

Improvements on crash problem.

notes.title: Release Notes for 16/04/2024
notes.notes:
Language


 Added Portuguese language support.

Bug Fixes


 Skill prices of the weapon Fenrir's Tooth are now set correctly.
 Temporarily removed an Ultimate that caused the player to have infinite health. (This Ultimate will be fixed & readded in the following patches.)
 Fixed an issue where the Rings weren't purchasable while playing with a gamepad.
